purpose: Pin the public GitHub timeline of the present NeuRosetta repository's PCA files so its July/August 2026 implementation is not misused as proof of the December 2025 Point_data producer.

source.caveat: GitHub repository creation metadata and Git author/committer timestamps answer different questions; the earliest commit timestamp predates repository creation, but the source tree at that initial commit contains only three non-code root files.

events.observation: The initial commit has no Python source tree and no PCA/geometry implementation.

events.interpretation: This July 2026 refactor is not evidence of the exact dependency or implementation present at the December 2025 artifact date.

proven: The current NeuRosetta GitHub repository was created after the historical Point_data.pkl public commit.
Although its initial commit timestamp is 2025-10-21, that commit tree contains no Python source files.
The first public PCA utility in this repository path history appears on 2026-07-27 and uses NumPy SVD.
The current geometry_utils PCA file was added on 2026-07-28 as a NumPy implementation using numpy.linalg.eigh, well after the December 2025 artifact.
not_proven: Whether equivalent code existed in the author's local/private working tree before it was pushed to GitHub.
Whether a pre-existing GeoJax or Neurosetta_legacy function was used by an uncommitted historical producer.
The exact function, dependency revision, subtype axis order, or serialization route that generated Subtype_evDir_x/y/z.
conclusion.relevant_pre_artifact_public_alternative: NikDrummond/GeoJax commit 33b0f8727ab447eff86e35a69c60c1f33b4d1513 (2025-05-02) exposes JAX PCA and caller-selected eigenvector ordering, but no producer invocation has been recovered.
